The answer is 4, based on my recollection of the literature rather than a derivation. I believe the result is that for a compact simple Lie group $G$ with bi-invariant metric, not $\operatorname{Sp}(n)$ for $n\ge 8$, $E_8$, $F_4$, or $G_2$, the singular set of a stable stationary harmonic map $u : M\to G$ has Hausdorff codimension at least 4. The general Schoen–Uhlenbeck-type theory gives only codimension at least 3, so the Lie-group structure would be needed to improve this by one. The excluded groups are the cases where that improvement fails.

ANSWER: 4
